name: Together
source:
In this world you'll be solving the mystery behind Rumbo's nightmares. Something that he remembers from his past still haunts him, even though he's trying to leave all of that behind, it feels impossible to do so. 

You'll go out on a journey along with Rumbo and his [i]best[/i] friend Baron to try and get rid of these nightmares once and for all. Will you know what to do to take Rumbo down the right path?

[From [url=https://team-together.itch.io/together]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界里，你将解开伦博噩梦背后的谜团。他一直试图抛下过去，可某段记忆仍在纠缠他，让他觉得无论如何都无法摆脱。

你将与伦博和他“最好”的朋友巴伦一同踏上旅程，试着彻底摆脱这些噩梦。你知道该怎么做，才能帮伦博走上正确的道路吗？

[来源：[url=https://team-together.itch.io/together]Itch.io[/url]]
